subject: Request: Meridian renewal — executive signoff for one-time concession + SLA uplift
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Meridian renewal — ask for exec-level concession approval

Hi team,

Quick summary: Meridian Health (renewal due 8/15) asked for a retention package after an RFP scare. They’re asking for a combination of discounts and an SLA uplift to stay. I’ve attached the latest SOW and their redlines.

Requested concessions from Meridian:
- One-time credit: originally asked for $60k; we should propose something lower.
- Term reset: they want us to reduce the 12‑month commitment to a 9‑month term to align with their fiscal year.
- SLA uplift: request to move from 99.9% to 99.95% with associated service credits.

Why this matters: Meridian is a large healthcare customer (pilot across 6 hospitals). Churn risk is high — they have an alternate vendor in the wings with a lower price and a strong procurement push. We estimate ~30% revenue at risk if they leave. The renewal ARR is $1.2M.

P&L impact (rough):
- 20% first-year discount = ~$240k revenue impact (front-loaded).
- $50k one-time credit reduces acceptance friction.
- SLA uplift increases exposure to credits but should be limited to a single quarter of credits not exceeding $25k.

Request: I am requesting executive signoff for a targeted retain package we can offer as a final option. My proposal (recommended):
1) One-time credit of $40,000 applied at renewal.
2) Temporary term reset to 9 months for this renewal only (followed by full 12‑month thereafter).
3) SLA uplift to 99.95% with a capped service-credit exposure of $25,000 for the first 12 months.
4) A 10% first-year discount (instead of their requested 20%).

If approved I’ll route the revised SOW and DocuSign to Meridian legal. We need signoff by 7/27 to get amendments processed before their procurement window closes.

Attachments: Meridian_SOW_v3.pdf, contract_redlines_20260725.pdf

Thanks — Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0136

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Meridian renewal — ask for exec-level concession approval

Thanks Rafael — good summary. A couple of questions before we escalate to Laura: 

1) How confident are we the SLA uplift is technically viable on their deployment profile? (I want an ops confirmation that 99.95% is reasonable without a permanent runbook change).
2) Do we have precedent for term reset to 9 months? If not, legal will push back; we need a hard justification and fallback language.
3) Can Finance confirm the net present value hit if we approve $40k + 10% discount? I want a one-line cost delta to include in the ask.

If we can get Ops and Finance to greenlight these points then I recommend we present the limited package Rafael proposed. If not, we should consider the $40k credit + a 6‑month SLA trial instead of full uplift.

Marcus
Marcus Lin
Head of Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com

Subject: Re: Meridian renewal — ask for exec-level concession approval

I've reviewed Rafael's ask and Marcus's points. Decision: APPROVE a constrained concession package to preserve the account while protecting our economics. Approvals below.

Approved package (final):
- One-time credit: $40,000 (to be documented in SOW).
- First-year discount: 10% (apply to first 12 months only).
- Term reset: approve a one-off 9‑month term, expressly for this renewal only; include language that next renewal will revert to standard 12‑month commitment. Legal to draft explicit sunset clause.
- SLA: uplift to 99.95% for 9 months with a service-credit cap of $25,000 in that period. We will revert SLA to standard language after renewal period unless a future commercial agreement is reached.

Conditions:
1) Finance to confirm final margin impact and sign off that the net ARR loss does not materially breach our quota recognition rules.
2) Legal to prepare a short addendum (SOW amendment) with the term reset and explicit sunset + service credit cap.
3) This package is one-time and requires Meridian's signature before 8/1.

Marcus/Grace — please drive Ops/Finance/Legal on the two bullets above and confirm by EOD Monday (7/27). Rafael — prepare the revised SOW and DocuSign; loop in Contracts at Meridian and offer the DocuSign link for signature.

I'll be available if Meridian requests any further concession, but nothing beyond the approved package without another exec review.

Laura Bennett
VP, North America Sales | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com

- One-time credit of $40,000 applied at contract execution.
- 10% discount on year 1 billing.
- One-off term reset to a 9‑month commitment for this renewal only; subsequent renewals will revert to a standard 12‑month term.

We appreciate your partnership and hope this package helps you keep momentum for the expanded deployment.
